title: Troubled Waters: A Polluted River
blurb: A factory plume drifts downstream. Clean it up, then campaign against the source.
hints: A plume flows downstream and hurts every tile it passes. Remove cleans one tile, but the factory keeps releasing more.
Campaign (3⚡) makes a threat 1 weaker for good. At 0 it has stopped for good: that is the way to win the ★★★.
Stars: ★ survive · ★★ finish with the ecosystem at least as healthy as you started · ★★★ every threat stopped.
realWorld: Never pour paint, chemicals or old medicines down a drain: use your local hazardous-waste drop-off, and join a river clean-up or water-quality monitoring group.
